name: Gunnamatta Surf Life Saving Club
signature: One of Victoria's most active ocean surf clubs — patrolling the Peninsula's most powerful beach and running one of its strongest Nippers programs
editorNote:
Gunnamatta SLSC has been keeping swimmers safe on one of Victoria's most challenging surf beaches since 1959. The club patrols Gunnamatta Ocean Beach on weekends and public holidays from late November through Easter, and its volunteer patrol teams are among the most experienced ocean lifesavers on the Peninsula.

The Nippers program at Gunnamatta is genuinely ocean-facing — kids learn real surf skills on a real surf beach rather than calm bay water. Age groups run from U6 through to U14, with Sunday morning sessions from late November through March. It is a formative experience for Peninsula kids and a compelling reason for families to base themselves near the ocean side of the Peninsula in summer.

The clubhouse has a cafe open on patrol days — worth stopping for a coffee after a surf or a walk on the beach.
whyWeGo: The best place to watch — or enrol your kids in — real ocean surf lifesaving on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Watch a Sunday morning Nippers session in January — hundreds of kids in the surf, it is one of the Peninsula's great community spectacles.
